purpose: Complete the mandatory exposed-development same-case comparison of the rejected own-history HGB candidate against the current v25 runtime estimator; this is diagnostic only and cannot qualify production.

window.note: Continuous current-v25 chronological replay spans the exact 2024Q4 and January2025 candidate evaluation events; no target rows are skipped.

runtime.predictionInputs: Only current v25 estimator behavior on finalized strictly-prior events; realized venue and target outcomes are never supplied to prediction.

joinIdentity: Exact contract/NFT address + event timestamp + normalized username; case-set fingerprint also includes the historical outcome to guard label mismatches.

reporting.uncertainty: 2000 deterministic identity-cluster bootstrap replicates, LCG seed 27092026, for paired secondary-premium mean-absolute-log-error improvement on common predictions.

interpretation.tuning: No candidate or gate tuning is permitted after viewing this comparison.
limitations: Both temporal folds and the fitted candidate have already been exposed during development.
This comparison measures historical paired agreement only; it cannot establish current-market accuracy or qualify the estimator.
The HGB candidate and v25 runtime use different model families/features by design; all event outcomes and event identities must be exactly paired.
A failed hard gate remains failed; no exposed-window variant is a replacement for untouched prospective qualification.
